Meet the game

The art of a well-planned heist.

Taking a whole painting would be too easy. In Pixel Heist, every color is a decision and every free dock is an opportunity. Direct your robotic crew as you uncover a work of art, one layer at a time.

Behind the heist

A museum full of secrets.
One small crew.

Step into Rocco and Sprocket’s world. Among gilded frames, night galleries, and tiny robots, every mission opens the door to another discovery. Follow the story through the game’s case panels.

  • Art-heist story panels
  • A tiny robotic crew with personality
  • A fresh puzzle behind every artwork
In-game screenshot

From puzzle to collection

Stay a little longer
after the last pixel.

Take a closer look at the works in your gallery. Switch between the pixel interpretation and the original artwork view, and read the story behind the piece. Make time for your collection before the next heist.

  • Pixel and original artwork views
  • Background information about each piece
  • A collection to explore at your own pace

Your first move

Three steps into the game.

Pixel Heist
  1. 01

    Choose your color.

    Read the colors at the front of the queue and check your free docks. Plan around the pixels your drones can actually reach.

  2. 02

    Clear a path.

    Drones collect reachable pixels of the matching color. Clear the outer layers and leave room for colors that are still sealed inside.

  3. 03

    Complete the artwork.

    Keep your sequence working until the final pixel. Explore the completed piece in your gallery, then take on the next mission.

A little help

A question before you play?

Game support
How do I play?

Place colored carriers in free docks. Drones collect matching pixels they can reach. Clear the outer pixels to reach the colors inside.

Where is my progress saved?

The current build stores progress and settings on your device. Take care of your save data before removing the app or changing devices.

Where can I download it?

Store links have not been announced yet. Official links will be added here when available.
